name: Sinocelltech Group Limited
summary: Sinocelltech Group Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, and production of recombinant proteins, antibody drugs, viral infections, and vaccines in China. The company offers Anjiayin, a third-generation recombinant coagulation factor VIII product for the treatment of hemophilia A; Anpingxi, an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody for the treatment of CD20-positive diffuse large B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma; Anjiarun, an adalimumab biosimilar for the treatment of various autoimmune diseases; Anbezu, a bevacizumab biosimilar for the treatment of various solid tumors; SCTV01, a series of recombinant protein vaccines for multiple variants of the new coronavirus; Fe…
